blocks.en: Abstract
blocks.zh: 摘要

blocks.en:
Mixture-of-Experts (MoE), popularized by large language models, is a promising paradigm for scaling visual generative models.
However, conventional token-wise MoE routes tokens independently within a homogeneous expert pool and regularizes expert usage toward uniformity, making it poorly matched to video data that is spatiotemporally redundant and semantically long-tailed.
We show that existing visual MoEs fall into a uniformity trap: semantically under-organized routing, compounded by uniform expert-usage regularization, scatters coherent patches across disparate experts, causing routing fragmentation and structural distortion.
To address this, we propose SplitMoE, a split-role sparse architecture that breaks the shackles of uniformity.
To accommodate the inherent semantic imbalance, we explicitly bifurcate the expert pool into semantic experts and generic experts, with semantic experts capturing high-level semantic abstraction and generic experts preserving residual visual information and flexible generative capacity.
Leveraging prototype-guided routing and pull-push regularization, SplitMoE enables tokens to cluster naturally by semantic attributes rather than arbitrary balancing constraints.
Extensive results show that under an equivalent activated-parameter budget, SplitMoE outperforms traditional load-balanced MoEs in convergence speed, routing coherence, and video generation quality across standard benchmarks.
By revealing an emergent coarse-to-fine denoising logic, SplitMoE provides the community with a modality-aware scaling path, serving as a critical reference for building large-scale video world models.
blocks.zh:
Mixture-of-Experts (MoE),被大型语言模型所普及,是放大视觉基因模型的有希望的范式.
然而,传统象征性的教育部路线在单一的专家库中独立显示,并使专家的用法规范化,使之与瞬息万变的冗余和长尾的视频数据不相称。
我们显示,现有的视觉教育部陷入一个统一的陷阱:由于组织不足,加上统一的专家使用规范化,分散了各行各业的专家的一致补丁,造成路线支离破碎和结构扭曲。
为了解决这个问题,我们提议SplitMoE,一种分裂作用的零散建筑,打破统一性的枷锁.
为了适应固有的语义不平衡,我们明确将专家库分为语义专家和通用专家,由语义专家捕捉高级语义抽象和通用专家保存剩余视觉信息和灵活的基因能力.
利用原型制导的路由和牵引-推式规范化,SplitMoE使令牌能够自然地通过语义属性而不是任意的平衡约束来集群.
广泛结果表明,在相当的激活参数预算中,SplitMoE在趋同速度、路由一致性和视频生成质量方面超越了传统的负载平衡的MOE。
SplitMoE通过揭示一种新兴的粗糙至精细的解析逻辑,为社区提供了一种模式感知的缩放路径,作为构建大规模视频世界模型的关键参考.

blocks.en: 1 Introduction
blocks.zh: 导言

blocks.en:
Diffusion Transformers (DiTs) [ 24 ] have made significant advances in high-fidelity video generation [ 20 , 8 , 7 , 14 ] , yet scaling their parameters to capture complex motion remains computationally prohibitive.
Mixture-of-Experts (MoE) provides a promising path toward scalable modeling by decoupling total model capacity from active FLOPs.
However, standard MoE architectures are developed for language models [ 15 , 4 , 3 ] ; nevertheless, current visual generative models [ 5 , 43 , 31 ] often naively adopt these language-centric designs, taking their cross-modal effectiveness for granted and assuming that mechanisms optimized for discrete syntax will naturally generalize to the highly redundant and heterogeneous spatiotemporal tokens of video.
blocks.zh:
传播变形器(DiTs)[24]在高可靠性视频生成[20,8,7,14]上取得了显著进步,然而缩放其参数以捕捉复杂的运动仍然在计算上令人无法接受.
Mixture-of-Experts(MOE)通过将总模型容量与活跃的FLOP脱钩,为可扩展模型提供了一条有希望的道路.
然而,为语言模型[15,4,3]开发了标准MOE架构;然而,目前的视觉遗传模型[5,43,31]往往天真地采用这些以语言为中心的设计,将其跨模式的有效性视为理所当然,并假设为离散语法优化的机制自然会通俗化到视频高度冗余和繁杂的spatiotemporal标志.

blocks.en:
In this study, we revisit one of the fundamental settings of standard MoE: load-balancing mechanisms which enforce tokens’ statistical uniformity across available experts when training.
We argue that such unique distributional characteristics are poorly aligned with the unstructured and imbalanced nature of video data.
While language tokens are often organized into distinguishable semantic units by discrete syntax, video tokens are highly imbalanced across different regions.
Unconstrained sparse routing in video diffusion features can therefore produce spatiotemporal fragmentation : neighboring patches from the same coherent object may be dispatched to different experts, while visually redundant background patches may dominate multiple experts (as illustrated in Fig. 1 (b)).
blocks.zh:
在这项研究中,我们重新审视了标准教育部的基本环境之一:在培训时对现有的专家实行标记统计统一性的负载平衡机制。
我们辩称,这种独特的分布特征与视频数据的无结构性和不平衡性不相一致。
虽然语言符号常常通过离散语法排列成可区分的语义单位,但视频符号在不同区域之间则高度不平衡.
因此,视频传播功能中不受限制的零星路由可以产生spatiotopal破碎:来自同一连贯对象的相邻补丁可能会被发送给不同的专家,而视觉冗余背景补丁则可能支配多个专家(如图1(b)所示).

blocks.en:
To investigate such a “uniformity trap”, we compare the self-similarity patterns of language and visual tokens in Fig. 2 (a).
Unlike language tokens exhibiting relatively high entropy and low cohesion, visual tokens are densely correlated and spatially continuous.
Directly routing such tokens leads the experts to redundantly specialize in ubiquitous visual patterns rather than distinct semantic entities.
We further group video tokens with off-the-shelf semantic segmentation masks and analyze their routed experts in Fig. 2 .
Two complementary properties are measured: semantic distinctiveness (Fig. 2 (b)) evaluates whether different semantic classes are assigned to more category-specific experts, and intra-sample routing dominance (Fig. 2 (c)) evaluates whether tokens from the same semantic region are consistently routed to the same expert.
High values in both metrics indicate routing that is discriminative across semantic classes and coherent within each semantic region.
Standard MoE has consistently low semantic distinctiveness and routing dominance across most semantic classes, indicating that tokens from the same region are often dispersed across experts.
Enforcing strict uniform allocation may therefore amplify spatiotemporal fragmentation, since tokens within semantically coherent regions are forced into uniform routing patterns.
blocks.zh:

直接使用这种符号使专家多余地专门研究无处不在的视觉模式,而不是独特的语义实体。

衡量的是两个互补属性:语义特性(图2(b))评价是否将不同的语义类分配给了更具体类别的专家,而样本内路由主导(图2(c))评价同一语义区的信物是否一致地向同一专家通路.
这两个指标值的高值表明,各语义类的路由具有歧视性,并且在每个语义区内部一致。
标准教育部在大多数语义类中一直保持较低的语义特征和路线主导地位,表明来自同一地区的符号往往分散在专家之间.
因此,实行严格的统一分配可能会扩大瞬间分裂,因为和谐一致的区域内的标志被迫采用统一的路线模式。

blocks.en:
Motivated by these observations, we propose SplitMoE, a structured routing framework that separates semantic abstraction from general visual residual modeling. As shown in Fig. 1 (b), SplitMoE partitions experts into a semantic branch and a generic branch.
The semantic branch is guided to route tokens from the same semantic region to consistent expert groups and to assign different semantic regions to more distinguishable expert groups, thereby improving semantic coherence while avoiding expert collapse. This effect is supported by the green bars in Fig. 2 : compared with standard MoE, our semantic branch achieves higher routing dominance across all semantic classes and stronger semantic distinctiveness for most categories.
This design addresses the fragmentation observed in common video MoE routing, where semantically similar regions may be split across unrelated experts.
As shown in Fig. 1 (c), semantically coherent token assignment encourages experts to develop more specialized capabilities, leading to better generation performance.
Meanwhile, the generic branch retains flexible capacity for residual variations that are not well captured by discrete semantic grouping.
In this way, SplitMoE avoids forcing all visual tokens into a single uniform routing space.
To ensure meaningful specialization and prevent semantic collapse, we introduce a Prototype-Guided Semantic Routing mechanism. We use prototypes as a bridge between visual model features and DiT visual tokens, guiding the router toward semantic-aware expert assignment.
blocks.zh:
基于这些观察,我们提出SplitMoE,一个结构化的路由框架,将语义抽象与一般视觉残余模型分离. 如图1(b)所示,SplitMoE分区将专家分成语义分支和通用分支.
语义分支被引导从同一个语义区域到一致的专家组的路标,并将不同的语义区域分配到更能区分的专家组,从而在避免专家崩溃的同时提高语义的一致性. 这种效果得到了图2中的绿条的支持:与标准MOE相比,我们的语义分支在所有语义类中实现了更高的路由支配性,并且大多数类的语义特性更强.
这一设计解决了常见视频MOE路由中观察到的零散问题,在这些路由中,相似的区域可能会被分散在无关的专家之间.
如图1(c)所示,协调划一的象征性任务鼓励专家发展更专门的能力,从而提高生成业绩。
同时,通用分支保留了剩余变异的灵活能力,这些变异没有被离散语义分组很好地捕捉.
通过这种方式,SplitMoE避免将所有视觉符号强迫进入一个统一的路由空间.
为了保证有意义的专业化和防止语义崩溃,我们引入了原型-Guided Semantic Routing机制. 我们使用原型作为视觉模型特性和DiT视觉符号之间的桥梁,引导路由器向语义意识专家任务的方向发展.

blocks.en:
More importantly, we demonstrate that this role-aware decoupling aligns with the semantic-to-detail generation order of the diffusion process [ 41 ] through Emergent Temporal Specialization. Without relying on any explicit timestep-conditioned routing constraints, SplitMoE naturally routes more capacity to Semantic Experts during the early, high-noise structural phase, and shifts more expert weights to Generic Experts during the final denoising stages. This emergent behavior validates the intuition behind our semantic-generic partition and establishes an effective paradigm for modeling heterogeneous video tokens.
In summary, our core contributions are threefold: • We propose SplitMoE, a sparse architecture tailored for video generation. By decoupling visual modeling into Semantic and Generic Experts, SplitMoE addresses the inherent cohesion of video tokens and mitigates spatiotemporal fragmentation and temporal flickering. • We introduce Prototype-Guided Semantic Routing, which uses learnable prototypes to bridge reconstructive visual features and DiT visual tokens. It enables semantic-aware expert assignment, reduces expert homogenization, and promotes meaningful specialization while preserving flexible residual modeling. • Under matched activated-parameter budgets, SplitMoE outperforms standard MoE and remains competitive with other baselines of comparable activated parameter counts. We provide empirical insights into Video-MoE routing dynamics and timestep analyses, which reveal a coarse-to-fine routing pattern consistent with denoising.
blocks.zh:
更重要的是,我们表明,这种角色意识的脱钩与传播过程的语义到细节生成顺序[41]通过Emergent Timoral Specialization相配合. SplitMoE在不依赖任何明确的时间步骤和附带条件的路由限制的情况下,自然在早期高噪音结构阶段将更多的能力输送给语义专家,并在最终解密阶段将更多的专家权重转移给通用专家。 这种突发行为验证了我们语义-基因分割背后的直觉,并建立了模拟各种视频符号的有效范例。
简而言之,我们的核心贡献有三:我们提议采用SplitMoE,这是专门为录像制作而设计的简陋建筑。 SplitMoE通过将视觉模型脱钩为语义专家和通用专家,解决了视频符号的内在内在凝聚力,并缓解了瞬间分裂和时间闪烁。 我们引入了原型 Guided Semanic Routing,它使用可学习的原型来连接重建视觉特征和DiT视觉符号. 它使语义意识专家能够分配,减少专家的同质化,促进有意义的专业化,同时保留灵活的残余模型。 • 支助 在匹配的激活参数预算下,SplitMoE优于标准MOE,并且仍然与其他可比激活参数计数基线具有竞争力. 我们对视频-MOE的路由动态和时序分析提供了经验性见解,揭示出一种与解密一致的粗到细的路由模式.

blocks.en: 2 Related Work
blocks.zh: 2 相关工作

blocks.en: Large-scale text-to-video generation. Text-to-video generation has advanced rapidly with the scaling of diffusion models and transformer architectures. Closed-source systems [ 26 , 21 , 22 , 8 , 14 , 18 , 27 , 19 , 30 ] have set high standards in visual fidelity, physical plausibility, and long-video generation. Meanwhile, open-source models have shifted from 3D U-Nets [ 1 ] to Diffusion Transformers [ 24 ] , with recent systems [ 11 , 13 , 25 , 34 , 35 ] combining DiT backbones, advanced autoencoders, and multimodal language models to approach proprietary performance. Despite this progress, open-source models still suffer from spatio-temporal semantic inconsistency, structural distortion, and temporal jitter, motivating more effective semantic representation and token-level control during generation.
blocks.zh: 大规模文字到视频生成. 文本到视频生成随着扩散模型和变压器架构的缩放而迅速进步. 闭源系统 [26, 21, 22, 8, 14, 18, 27, 19, 30] 设定了视觉忠贞,身体合理,长视频生成的高标准. 与此同时,开源模型已经从3D U-Nets [1] 转向了传播变换器 [24],最近的系统[11,13,25,34,35] 结合了DiT主干线,高级自动编码器,以及多模式语言模型来接近专有性能. 尽管取得了这些进展,但开放源代码模型仍然受到语义不一致、结构扭曲和时态紧张的困扰,在生成过程中激发了更有效的语义表述和符号级控制。

blocks.en: Mixture of experts for visual generation. MoE effectively scales LLMs [ 15 , 4 , 3 ] by offering large capacity with manageable inference cost through sparse routing. This paradigm has extended to visual generation, where recent works [ 5 , 2 , 43 , 31 , 39 ] show that sparse architectures improve diffusion transformers for image synthesis. For video generation, existing methods [ 35 ] adopt coarse timestep-level MoE routing, assigning one expert to all tokens at each denoising stage. While effective, this overlooks the spatio-temporal heterogeneity within video frames. Token-level routing can address this limitation but introduces another challenge: conventional load-balancing objectives [ 6 ] uniformly scatter tokens across experts, disrupting strong video semantic correlations and temporal consistency.
blocks.zh: 混合专家进行视觉生成. 教育部通过稀少的路由,提供大容量、可管理的推论成本,从而有效衡量LLMS[15、4、3]。 这个范式已经扩展到视觉生成,其中最近的作品[5,2,43,31,39]显示,稀疏的建筑改善了图像合成的传播变压器. 对于视频生成,现有方法[35]采用粗细的时序级的MOE路由,在每个调试阶段指派一名专家负责所有符号. 这虽然有效,但忽略了视频框架内的时空异质性。 Token级的路由可以解决这一局限性,但也带来了另一个挑战:常规的负载平衡目标[6]统一分散在专家之间,破坏强大的视频语义相关性和时间一致性。

blocks.en: Recent works have addressed homogeneous routing in static image generation. ProMoE [ 38 ] uses prototype-guided routing to segregate conditional and unconditional tokens, while MammothModa2 [ 29 ] decouples generation and understanding experts in a unified autoregressive-diffusion framework. However, they focus on conditioning types or task modalities rather than video structure. In contrast, SplitMoE targets the long-tailed spatio-temporal redundancy of video by splitting experts into semantic and generic pools, decoupling high-level structural abstraction from localized high-frequency reconstruction.
blocks.zh: 近期的作品解决了静态图像生成中的同质路径问题. ProMoE [38] 使用原型导线将有条件和无条件的符号分离,而Mammoth Moda2 [29] 在统一的自旋扩散框架中解析生成和理解专家. 然而,它们侧重于配置类型或任务模式,而不是视频结构. 相比之下,SplitMoE则通过将专家分为语义和通用集合,将高层次的结构抽象与本地化的高频重建脱钩,从而瞄准视频的长尾时空冗余.

blocks.en: 3.2 SplitMoE: Split-Role Visual Experts
blocks.zh: 3.2 SplitMoE: Split-Role视觉专家

blocks.en: We propose SplitMoE, which explicitly decouples the MoE layer into specialized functional roles. By utilizing continuous VAE features as a teacher signal to anchor tokens to learnable semantic prototypes, our approach separates high-level semantic abstraction from low-level generic reconstruction.

blocks.en: 3.3 Prototype-Guided Semantic Routing
blocks.zh: 3.3 原型指导语义路线

blocks.en: We introduce a set of learnable prototypes 𝒫 = { 𝐩 1 , … , 𝐩 M s } \mathcal{P}=\{\mathbf{p}_{1},\ldots,\mathbf{p}_{M_{s}}\} that act as a semantic bottleneck between continuous VAE features and discrete semantic experts. Inspired by SRA2 [ 36 ] , we use clean VAE features as a cost-free guidance space for the rich visual priors without relying on external representation models. Each prototype 𝐩 m \mathbf{p}_{m} serves as a semantic anchor for one semantic expert in the VAE feature space. To obtain a stable prototype topology, we decouple router learning from prototype optimization through two objectives.
blocks.zh: 我们推出一套可学习的原型 P = { p 1,..., p M s }\ mathcal{ P}=\{\ mathbf{p}_{1},\ ldots,\ mathbf{p}_{M_{s}}\}},作为连续VAE特性与离散语义专家之间的语义瓶颈. 受SRA2[36]的启发,我们使用干净的VAE特性作为丰富视觉前身的免费指导空间,而不依赖外部代表模型. 每个原型p m\mathbf{p}_{m}作为VAE特性空间中一位语义专家的语义锚. 为了获得稳定的原型地形学,我们通过两个目标来解析路由器从原型优化中学习.

blocks.en: For the i i -th visual token, we compute a teacher assignment 𝐪 i \mathbf{q}_{i} by comparing its corresponding clean VAE feature 𝐟 i \mathbf{f}_{i} with the semantic prototypes using temperature-scaled cosine similarity. The resulting 𝐪 i \mathbf{q}_{i} is treated as a fixed target. Meanwhile, the router takes the DiT visual token 𝐱 i \mathbf{x}_{i} as input and predicts a semantic routing distribution 𝐫 i \mathbf{r}_{i} from the logits. We align this router prediction with the VAE-prototype induced soft target using Kullback–Leibler divergence: ℒ align = 1 N ∑ i = 1 N KL ( 𝐪 i ∥ 𝐫 i ) . \mathcal{L}_{\rm align}=\frac{1}{N}\sum_{i=1}^{N}\operatorname{KL}(\mathbf{q}_{i}\,\|\,\mathbf{r}_{i}). (7) This objective trains the router to assign visually similar tokens to consistent semantic prototypes, while the stop-gradient operation prevents the router objective from directly distorting the prototype topology.

blocks.en: 4.1 Implementation Details
blocks.zh: 4.1 详细执行情况

blocks.en:
We upcycle the low-noise checkpoint of Wan 2.2 [ 35 ] by replacing the dense feed-forward networks at even-numbered layers from 15 to 35 with sparse MoE layers, while keeping all other components unchanged. This alternating design balances stable global feature extraction with expert specialization [ 17 ] . Each MoE layer contains one continuously active shared expert and 100 routed experts, partitioned into 20 semantic and 80 generic experts. For each token, a Top- 8 8 router activates K s = 2 K_{s}{=}2 semantic experts and K g = 6 K_{g}{=}6 generic experts. By matching the active intermediate dimension of the dense baseline, our model activates 14B of its 27B total parameters per forward pass, maintaining computational parity with the dense model.
We initialize experts from the dense FFN to preserve pre-trained generative priors and train all models under the same 80k-step optimization setting.
blocks.zh:
我们把Wan 2.2 [35] 的低噪声检查点循环起来,用稀疏的MOE层取代15至35的偶数层密集的向导网络,同时保持所有其他组件不变。 这种交替设计平衡了稳定的全球特征提取与专家专业化[17]。 每个 教育部层包括一名持续积极的共享专家和100名路由专家,分为20名语义专家和80名通用专家。 每一枚令牌,一个Top-8 8路由器激活K s = 2 K_{s}{=}2语义专家,K g = 6 K_{g}{=}6 通用专家. 通过匹配稠密基线的活性中间维度,我们的模型每向前传激活其27B总参数中的14B,保持与稠密模型的计算等价.
我们从密集的FFN中初始化专家,以保留预先训练的基因前科,并在相同的80k步优化设置下对所有模型进行培训.

blocks.en: 4.2 Experimental Setup
blocks.zh: 4.2 实验设置

blocks.en: To isolate component contributions, we compare same-source variants sharing the Wan 2.2 low-noise checkpoint, training data, step count, and inference settings. Unless specified, all MoE variants share the same configuration as in Sec. 4.1 . Dense Wan2.2-FT finetunes the original dense model identically. Wan2.2-MoE converts Wan 2.2 into a standard MoE (100 generic experts, Top- 8 8 routing), representing our model without the semantic branch. SplitMoE w/o ProtoGuidance (PG) retains the 20/80 semantic-generic partition and dual-track routing but omits VAE teacher features, semantic prototypes, ℒ align \mathcal{L}_{\rm align} , and ℒ proto \mathcal{L}_{\rm proto} . SplitMoE w/o Pull and SplitMoE w/o Push respectively remove the attractive and repulsive terms of ℒ proto \mathcal{L}_{\rm proto} . Full SplitMoE incorporates all proposed components. This protocol effectively disentangles dense fine-tuning, sparse scaling, role-aware expert partitioning, and prototype-guided semantic specialization.

SplitMoE w/o Proto Guideance (PG) 保留了20/80语义-基因分区和双轨路由,但省略了VAE的师资特征,语义原型,L对齐的\mathcal{L}_{\rm对齐},以及Lproto的\mathcal{L}_{\rm proto}. SplitMoE w/o Pull和SplitMoE w/o Push分别删除了Lpoto\mathcal{L}_{\rm proto}的有吸引力和反感的术语. Full Split MoE 包含所有拟议组件. 这个协议有效地分散了密集的微调,稀疏的缩放,角色意识专家的分割,以及原型导语义的专业化.

blocks.en:
We compare SplitMoE against a wide range of SOTA text-to-video generation models, including CogVideoX-1.5 [ 40 ] , Mochi [ 33 ] , HunyuanVideo [ 13 ] , LongCat-Video [ 34 ] , LTX-2 [ 9 ] , Wan2.2 [ 35 ] and OmniWeaving (think) [ 23 ] .
All videos are generated using the default inference settings of each respective model with 81 frames.

我们比较SplitMoE与一系列SOTA文本到视频生成模型,包括CogVideoX-1.5 [40],Mochi [33],HunyuanVideo [13],LongCat-Video [34],LTX-2 [9],Wan2.2 [35]和OmniWeaving (think) [23].
所有视频都使用每个相关模型的默认推论设置生成,设定有81帧.

blocks.en: We evaluate SplitMoE on two complementary benchmarks. VBench-2.0 [ 42 ] , which is an upgraded version of VBench [ 12 ] , assesses intrinsic faithfulness across five capability dimensions: Creativity, Commonsense, Controllability, Human Fidelity, and Physics, using a combination of state-of-the-art VLMs/LLMs and specialist anomaly detectors. T2V-CompBench [ 32 ] targets compositional generation quality via MLLM-based, detection-based, and tracking-based metrics across three dimensions: Consistent Attribute, Interaction, and Numeracy.
blocks.zh: 我们对SplitMoE进行两个补充基准的评估。 V Bench-2.0 [42],是V Bench [12]的升级版本,它利用最先进的VLMs/LLMs和特别异常探测器的组合,在五个能力层面评估内在的忠诚度:创造力,常识,可控性,人类菲德尔力,以及物理学. T2V-CompBench[32]通过基于MLLM的、基于检测的和基于跟踪的衡量标准,针对三个维度的组分生成质量: 一致性属性、相互作用和数值。

blocks.en: 4.3 Quantitative Comparison
blocks.zh: 4.3 定量比较

blocks.en:
Table 1 reports quantitative results on VBench-2 and T2V-CompBench. Our method achieves competitive performance across multiple evaluation dimensions. Compared with Wan2.2, it improves Creativity and Human Fidelity, suggesting that the proposed routing design benefits diverse content generation and human-centric video synthesis. On T2V-CompBench, our method obtains competitive compositional-alignment results, indicating that the introduced MoE structure preserves text-video consistency under compositional prompts. VBench scores for LongCat-Video and HunyuanVideo follow the LongCat-Video paper, and T2V-CompBench scores for CogVideoX-1.5 and Mochi follow the T2V-CompBench benchmark.
Since independently developed models may differ in training data, scale, compute budget and post-training recipes, we use controlled same-source ablations to isolate the architectural contribution. The following section therefore focuses on MoE-specific comparisons.

表1报告了V Bench-2和T2V-Comp Bench的定量结果。 我们的方法实现了多个评价层面的竞争性业绩。 与Wan2.2相比,它改进了创意和人气Fidelity,表明拟议的路由设计有利于不同的内容生成和以人为本的视频合成. 在T2V-Comp Bench上,我们的方法获得了竞争性的组装-对齐结果,表明引入的MOE结构在组装提示下保持文本-视频的一致性. V Bench对LongCat-Video和HunyuanVideo的分数跟随LongCat-Video的论文,T2V-Comp Bench对CogVideoX-1.5和Mochi的分数跟随T2V-Comp Bench的基准.

blocks.en: 4.4 Qualitative Comparisons
blocks.zh: 4.4 定性比较

blocks.en: For a fair comparison, we use examples from VBench2. In Fig. 4 , most baselines follow text prompts well, with Wan2.2 showing high visual quality and LTX-2 producing realistic effects. In the watermelon-cutting case, however, baselines struggle with complex object interactions: Wan2.2, LongCat-Video, and LTX-2 show local distortions as the action progresses, while the dashed boxes highlight unnatural deformation and fusion of hand morphology and watermelon geometry. OmniWeaving further suffers from abrupt content changes and inter-frame blurring. In contrast, our method maintains temporal consistency, stable physical boundaries, and structural details throughout the action. The horse case evaluates complex motion transitions from standing to running, where baselines produce multi-leg artifacts and structural anomalies under large spatiotemporal changes. Our method yields a smoother transition and preserves accurate physiological structure, benefiting from our split experts and semantic routing.
blocks.zh: 为了进行公平的比较,我们使用来自V Bench2的例子。 在图4中,大多数基线都遵循文字提示,Wan2.2显示高视觉质量,LTX-2产生现实效果。 然而,在西瓜切除案中,基线与复杂的物体相互作用发生斗争:Wan2.2,LongCat-Video,和LTX-2,随着动作的进展,显示局部扭曲,而破碎的盒子则突出非自然变形和组合的手形态和西瓜几何. OmniWeaving还受到内容突变和框架间模糊的影响。 相比之下,我们的方法在整个行动中保持了时间一致性、稳定的物理界限和结构细节。 马案评价复杂运动从站立到运行的过渡,在大瞬间变化下,基线会产生多腿文物和结构异常. 我们的方法产生更平稳的过渡,保留了准确的生理结构,受益于我们分裂的专家和语义路线.

blocks.en: 4.5 Ablation Studies
blocks.zh: 4.5 阅读研究

blocks.en: Tab. 2 compares training and inference speed under an iso-activated-parameter budget of 14B. Both our method and the baseline MoE show a slight per-iteration latency overhead over the dense model, mainly due to routing operations and memory bandwidth bottlenecks. Compared with the baseline MoE, our architecture adds negligible overhead and maintains highly comparable speed.
blocks.zh: 标签2比较了14B等效参数预算下的培训和推论速度。 我们的方法和基线的教育部都显示,在密集模型上存在轻微的偶入性纬度,这主要是由于路由操作和内存带宽瓶颈。 与基线教育部相比,我们的建筑增加了可忽略不计的间接费用,保持高度可比的速度。

blocks.en:
We evaluate sparse capacity scaling by comparing SplitMoE with a dense fine-tuning baseline. As shown in the first row of Table 1 , Dense Wan2.2-FT fine-tunes the low-noise Wan2.2 model on the same training data and evaluates it on VBench-2. Under the same active-parameter budget, the full SplitMoE outperforms this dense baseline across all evaluation dimensions, indicating that MoE upcycling raises capacity and the performance ceiling without increasing per-token activated parameters. The validation diffusion loss in Fig. 5 (a) further supports this trend: SplitMoE converges faster, reaches comparable loss with roughly 70% of the training steps, and maintains lower loss throughout training. These results show that our upcycling strategy preserves dense-model optimization stability while improving representational capacity through structure-aware sparse routing.
Notably, whereas the official Wan2.2 uses a high-/low-noise dual-model ensemble, Dense Wan2.2-FT is trained only from the low-noise checkpoint and thus naturally underperforms the full ensemble due to missing high-noise priors and reduced capacity.
blocks.zh:
我们通过将SplitMoE与密集的微调基线进行比较来评估容量的分散。 如表1第一行所示,Dense Wan2.2-FT在同一个训练数据上微调低噪音的Wan2.2模型,并在V Bench-2上评价. 在同一活动参数预算下,SplitMoE的全版业绩超过了这一覆盖所有评价层面的密集基线,表明MOE的升降提高了容量和性能上限,没有增加每盘激活参数. 图5 (a)中的验证扩散损失进一步证实了这一趋势: SplitMoE更快地汇合起来,在大约70%的训练阶段达到相当的损失,在整个训练过程中保持较低的损失. 这些结果表明,我们的升降战略保持了密集模式优化的稳定性,同时通过结构感知的稀疏路由提高了代表能力。
值得注意的是,虽然官方的Wan2.2采用高/低噪音双型综艺节目,但Dense Wan2.2-FT只接受低噪音检查站的训练,因此,由于缺少高噪音前科和容量减少,其全型综艺节目自然表现不佳。

blocks.en: We compare SplitMoE with two MoE baselines using similar expert configurations and parameter budgets. As shown in Table 1 and Fig. 4 , Wan2.2-MoE converts the low-noise Wan2.2 model into a standard MoE and fine-tunes it on the same data, while SplitMoE w/o PG keeps the same 20–80 expert partition as SplitMoE but removes prototype guidance. Their similar performance suggests that expert partitioning alone brings limited gains without explicit semantic guidance. In the left example in Fig. 4 , the watermelon struggles to maintain its complete semantics. In contrast, the full SplitMoE performs better on semantics-sensitive dimensions such as Human Fidelity and Physics, indicating that prototype-guided semantic routing improves expert specialization beyond naive sparse scaling. Fig. 5 (b) supports this conclusion, as removing the semantic branch yields higher validation diffusion loss than the full model.
blocks.zh: 我们利用类似的专家配置和参数预算,将SplitMoE与两个MOE基线进行比较. 如表1和图4所示,Wan2.2-MoE将低噪音的Wan2.2模型转换为标准MOE,并在相同数据上对其进行微调,SplitMoE w/o PG则保留与SplitMoE相同的20–80专家分区,但删除了原型指导. 它们的类似表现表明,单靠专家分治,在没有明确语义指导的情况下,收益有限。 在图4的左例中,西瓜挣扎着保持其完整的语义. 相比之下,完整的SplitMoE在诸如Human Fidelity和Physics等对语义敏感的维度上表现得更好,表明原型制导语义的路由改进了专家的专业性,超越了天真的稀有的缩放. 图5(b)支持这一结论,因为删除语义分支产生比完整模型更高的验证扩散损失。

blocks.en: Figure 5 : Ablation study analysis.
blocks.zh: 图5:校准研究分析。

blocks.en: Figure 6 : Comparison of spatial routing and expert loads. (a) Baseline MoE scatters correlated patches across experts under strict capacity constraints, causing fragmented routing and poor spatiotemporal consistency. (b) SplitMoE routes coherent entities to Semantic Experts and residual textures to Generic Experts, achieving stable utilization without enforcing uniformity.
blocks.zh: 图6:空间路由和专家载荷比较. (a) 基线教育部在严格的能力限制下将相关补丁分散在专家之间,造成路径支离破碎,时间上的一致性差。 (b) SplitMoE将连贯的实体通向语义专家,将剩余纹理通向普通专家,实现稳定的利用,而不强制统一。

blocks.en: We ablate the two complementary terms in ℒ proto \mathcal{L}_{\rm proto} to test whether prototype guidance needs balanced attraction and repulsion. As shown in Table 1 , using only one term does not reliably improve quantitative metrics and can even underperform the variant without prototype guidance, since partial supervision may introduce a biased routing prior rather than a stable semantic partition. Fig. 5 (b) shows the same trend in validation diffusion loss, where removing either term worsens optimization against the full model. The VAE-space visualization in Fig. 5 (c) explains these failure modes. Without push, pull attracts prototypes toward dominant visual regions, preventing full coverage of the VAE manifold and limiting the semantic experts’ representation space. Without pull, push drives many prototypes away from the data manifold, producing underused or dead semantic experts and weakening semantic routing. Thus, pull and push form a coupled mechanism: pull anchors prototypes to meaningful visual semantics, while push prevents redundant collapse. Together, they yield a balanced prototype layout that supports effective semantic expert specialization.
blocks.zh: 我们放弃了L proto\mathcal{L}_{\rm proto}中两个互补的术语,以测试原型制导是否需要平衡的吸引力和反感. 如表1所示,只使用一个术语并不能可靠地改进定量计量,甚至可以在没有原型指导的情况下低估变体的性能,因为部分监管可能会引入偏颇的路径,先行而非稳定的语义分区. 图5(b)显示在验证扩散损失方面有同样的趋势,删除其中任一术语都会使优化工作与整个模型相比更加恶化。 图5(c)中的VAE-空间可视化解释了这些故障模式. 在不推动的情况下,拉力会吸引原型投向主导视觉区域,阻止全面覆盖VAE多面体,并限制语义专家的代表空间. 不拉动,推动许多原型远离数据多面,产生使用不足或死亡的语义专家,削弱语义路线. 因此,拉力和推力形成一个偶联机制:拉锚原型到有意义的视觉语义上,同时推力防止冗余的崩溃. 它们共同产生平衡的原型布局,支持有效的语义专家专业化.

blocks.en: Consistent with Fig. 2 , where standard MoE shows low semantic distinctiveness and intra-region routing dominance, Fig. 6 (a) visualizes how this mismatch appears spatially and temporally. The Top-1 expert maps across frames show that coherent regions such as the horse and barn are not routed consistently. As highlighted by the dashed boxes, standard routing produces three artifacts: (i) Temporal jitter , where similar regions switch experts across frames; (ii) Spatial striping , where homogeneous areas are artificially split to satisfy load constraints; and (iii) Semantic fragmentation , where adjacent tokens from the same object scatter across unrelated experts. These results indicate that rigid token-level balancing is ill-suited to video tokens. In contrast, Fig. 6 (b) shows that SplitMoE assigns coherent object regions to stable semantic experts while using the generic branch to absorb residual textures and backgrounds, thereby reducing jitter, striping, and fragmentation.
blocks.zh: 与图2相一致的是,标准教育部显示的语义特征低,区域内部的路由占支配地位,图6(a)可视化这种不匹配在空间和时间上的出现。 Top-1跨帧专家地图显示,马和谷仓等连贯的区域没有连贯一致的路由. 正如破碎的盒子所强调的那样,标准路由可产生三种文物:(一) 瞬息万变(Tempolar jitter),即类似区域互换专家跨帧;(二) 空间条纹,即同质区域被人为分割以满足负载限制;(三) 语义条纹,即同一物体的相邻标志散落在无关专家之间。 这些结果表明,僵硬的象征性平衡不适合视频标志。 相比之下,图6(b)显示,SplitMoE向稳定的语义专家分配了连贯的对象区域,同时利用通用分支吸收残余的纹理和背景,从而减少焦虑、条纹和分裂。

blocks.en: We further track the routing weights assigned to semantic experts over a 50-step denoising trajectory in Fig. 5 (d). The semantic weight peaks in the early high-noise stage, around steps 10–15, when the model establishes global layout, object placement, and coarse semantic structure. It then gradually decreases as denoising shifts toward local appearance and detail refinement. This coarse-to-fine pattern shows that the semantic branch is not redundant sparse capacity; instead, it learns a stage-dependent role, allocating semantic computation to the phases where high-level structure formation is most needed.
blocks.zh: 我们进一步跟踪图5(d)中50步去声轨迹分配给语义专家的路线权重。 语义重量高峰在早期的高噪阶段,大约为10–15步,当模型建立全局布局,对象布置,粗糙的语义结构. 然后随着对当地外观和细节的完善的取消而逐渐减少。 这种粗体到细体的图案表明语义分支并不是冗余的零散容量;相反,它学习了一个依赖阶段的角色,将语义计算分配到最需要高级结构形成阶段.

blocks.en: 5 Conclusion
blocks.zh: 5 结论

blocks.en: In this work, we identify the uniformity trap as a key limitation of LLM-style MoE routing for video diffusion and propose SplitMoE, a split-role MoE that separates semantic abstraction from general visual residual modeling. With semantic-generic expert partitioning, prototype-guided routing, and pull-push regularization, SplitMoE improves convergence, routing coherence, and generation quality under matched activated-parameter budgets. Its timestep-aware routing reveals an emergent coarse-to-fine pattern, suggesting modality-aware sparse routing as a useful direction. Limitations include reliance on frozen visual features and sparse-routing overhead, motivating future work on adaptive partitioning, efficient distributed routing, and broader video generation tasks.
blocks.zh: 在这部作品中,我们确定统一陷阱是LLM风格的MOE路由用于视频传播的关键限制,并提议SplitMoE,一种将语义抽象与一般视觉残余模型分离的分化作用的MOE. SplitMoE通过语义 -- -- 基因专家分区、原型 -- -- 导线和牵引 -- -- 推进正规化,在匹配的激活参数预算下,改进了趋同、路由一致性和生成质量。 它的时步感知路由揭示出一种新兴的粗对细模式,建议模式感知的稀疏路由作为有用的方向. 限制包括依赖冷冻的视觉特征和稀疏的路面管理,激励今后在适应性分区方面的工作,高效的分布式路由,以及更广泛的视频生成任务。
